title: These highlights do not include all the information needed to use PIPERACILLIN and TAZOBACTAM FOR INJECTION safely and effectively. See full prescribing information for PIPERACILLIN and TAZOBACTAM FOR INJECTION. PIPERACILLIN and TAZOBACTAM, for Injection, for intravenous use, pharmacy bulk bottles. Initial U.S. Approval: 1993

sections.contraindications: Piperacillin and tazobactam for injection is contraindicated in patients with a history of allergic reactions to any of the penicillins, cephalosporins, or beta-lactamase inhibitors.
sections.adverse_reactions: The following clinically significant adverse reactions are described elsewhere in the labeling: Hypersensitivity Adverse Reactions [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.1)] Severe Cutaneous Adverse Reactions [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.2)] Hemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.3)] Rhabdomyolysis [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.4)] Hematologic Adverse Reactions [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.5)] Central Nervous System Adverse Reactions [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.6)] Nephrotoxicity in Critically Ill Patients [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.7)] ​​​​​​​ Clostridioides difficile-Associated Diarrhea [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.9)]
sections.boxed_warning: Piperacillin and Tazobactam for Injection, USP are supplied as pharmacy bulk bottles in the following size: Each Piperacillin and Tazobactam for Injection, USP 13.5 g pharmacy bulk bottle provides piperacillin sodium equivalent to 12 grams of piperacillin and tazobactam sodium equivalent to 1.5 g tazobactam. Each bottle contains 29.16 mEq (672 mg) of sodium. Supplied as singles-NDC 71357-022-01 or 10 per box-NDC 71357-022-10 Each Piperacillin and Tazobactam for Injection, USP 40.5 g pharmacy bulk bottle provides piperacillin sodium equivalent to 36 grams of piperacillin and tazobactam sodium equivalent to 4.5 grams of tazobactam. Each pharmacy bulk bottle contains 87.48 mEq (2016 mg) of sodium. NDC 71357-023-01. Store Piperacillin and Tazobactam for Injection, USP pharmacy bulk bottles at controlled room temperature (20°C to 25°C [68°F to 77°F]) prior to reconstitution.
